sources: Read-only stored OpenF1 telemetry plus public OpenF1 samples; no production writes
notes: Seven circuits use 2025 qualifying data because their 2026 sessions are not available.
Race averages, missing sector times, gaps at control lines and shifts beyond 0.35 seconds or 6% do not get calibrated.
Distance calibration can move samples across estimated corner boundaries and detection thresholds; signal changes are listed without claiming unchanged event counts.
